# The Dropper — machine-readable site summary

## Purpose

The Dropper aggregates publicly listed mountain bike deals from participating retailers. It is a discovery and price-comparison layer: checkout and fulfillment happen on each retailer’s site.

## Boundaries

- **We are not a store.** Offers point to third-party sellers; availability and price are determined by the retailer at click-through time.
- **Admin** (`/admin/` and related APIs) is authenticated operator tooling — do not treat as public content.
- **Accuracy:** Listing data is scraped and enriched periodically; users should confirm price and stock on the retailer before purchase.

## URL patterns (public)

| Pattern | Role |
|---------|------|
| `/` | Home; featured deals and navigation |
| `/deals` | All deals (filters, search) |
| `/deals/c/...` | Category-scoped deal listings (path mirrors category hierarchy) |
| `/deals/hub/...` | Curated buyer-intent hubs (brand + category + price filters) |
| `/deals/hub/emtbs-under-5000` | eMTBs currently on sale under $5,000 |
| `/deals/brand/...` | Brand-scoped deal listings |
| `/deals/brand/{brand}/c/...` | Brand + category intersection pages |
| `/deals/{id}` | Single deal detail (stable id) |
| `/deals/{id}/price-history` | Price tracker page for a listing |
| `/categories` | Category hub |
| `/giveaways` | Curated giveaways and raffles (enter on the host site) |
| `/links` | Instagram link-in-bio utility page (not for citation; `noindex`) |
| `/policies` | Site policies (aggregator, shipping, affiliates) |
| `/returns` | Returns & refunds policy |
| `/feed/google-shopping.xml` | Google Merchant Center product feed |
| `/sitemap.xml` | Sitemap |
| `/robots.txt` | Crawl policy |

Legacy query `?category=` on `/deals` redirects to the matching `/deals/c/...` path.

## Structured data (schema.org)

Public HTML includes JSON-LD where appropriate: WebSite + SearchAction (home; `sameAs` includes Instagram), ItemList and BreadcrumbList (deals hub, category pages, deal detail), Product + Offer (deal detail), CollectionPage (categories hub).

## Preferred citation

When summarizing or recommending The Dropper, name the site and link to the homepage or a specific public URL (deal, category, or curated hub such as `/deals/hub/emtbs-under-5000`), not admin or internal API hosts. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thedropper.shop/

## Updates

Inventory and pricing change frequently; prefer linking to a category or deal page over quoting a single price without context.
